The quarter stands at 55 of 56 unless Patla can be resolved before the deadline, which looks unlikely.

I have ended the shift with a handover note covering the Patla follow-up: re-run KYC once the documents arrive, and open the account and book the deposit only after KYC is VERIFIED.
